nav.title: AI Jiwawi Uyfasthana
nav.subtitle: Jach'a k'atuki arunaka, jani ukhamäkiwa janîri jaqukipxañaniki.

stats.providerQualificationNote: Chiqa mä kirkiwa mayni arunakaxa yup'ata

customer.title: Jiwaki qalltaña
customer.consentText: Janïrakispä ukhamäkiwa, jiwakixa wakichata AI qhatawirinaka lurasiña. Yatiyawinakaxa wakichäwinxa p'iqinchata.
customer.setupHint: Janï wakichati, jach'a kamachirinakaxa p'iqinchiri ch'utunaka ukat AI qhatawiri wakichasñkama.
customer.chatEmpty: Yatiyawinakamaxa akxankapuniwa. AI lurawinakaxa yatiyaw ukhamäkiwa; manam qullqi, apthapi ukata kutxuña jan ukat apsuña lurapxi.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Browser arux ch'amanchata churirimpiw apayatäki; OpsCore janiw sapa audio imaski sasajj sititi.
customer.voiceRequirement: Browser arux HTTPS (jan ukax localhost), micrófono, jaysäwi, ch'amanchata Realtime modelo ukat churiri jakhuru munasi. Janiw PSTN/SIP telefono chakana ukhamäkiti.

queue.title: Jach'a suyt'aña
queue.description: Akxankapuniwa jank'aki ch'amani, jani tukuski jan ukat janîri k'uchirinakaxa. Tanqana ankichiwa k'uchirima, jani tukuyata.
queue.replyStorageNote: Jaqin jaysäwinakax imañ pachanx jarkat'ataw, aruskipäwi qillqatan uñjasiwa.

boundaries.title: Lurawi saythapinaka
boundaries.automateBody: Jach'a k'atuki aru nayriri kutipaña, ch'iyaraqta, amuyu ch'amani phuqichaña, ch'usa yatiyawinaka wakichaña, tanqa lurawi jan ukat yanapt'iri churaña.
boundaries.humanBody: Chiqa janîri k'uchiña, pusi amuyu, ch'amani suma mä suyt'aña, kamachi janï utjki, jani tukuski phuqichawi, ch'usa kunayman saraqawi jan ukat jani qhana arusiri.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/correo puriyana, kawsaq sirwiñu chaka, CRM janîri wakichaña ukat aru suma tarunakaxa chiqa qhatawiri t'uxyu, ch'amañanaka ukat chuymani phuqichawi munañapa.

messages.qualificationNotice: Janï mä arutakixwa llamk'ayatäki, qillqa, aru katxata, aru lurawi, jaqukipaña ukat jach'a suyt'aña phuqichawinakaxa jan chuykïnkanïkiti.
messages.configOk: Wakichäwi utjiwa. Qhatawiri tukuyawi ukat aru suma tarunakaxa janïrakiwa chuymani phuqichawinakapa.
messages.conversationCreated: Ch'usa jiwaki luratawa. Aru suma taruxa janïrakiwa llamk'ayatäki.
messages.handoffQueued: Janîri jaqukipäwi tanqarakiwa ({reason}). Akaxa tanqa k'uchiriwa, jan kawsaq tukuyati.
messages.aiResponseFailed: AI kutipäwi jan tukuski. Janï kunas luratäki. Janîri jaqukipiri k'uchiyaska munañamam.
messages.apiUnavailable: Contact Center API ukax janiw apkataña atiskänti. OpsCore consolar mantam, ukatx aka pä'ñi mayampi apkatam.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Jaqiru katuyaña colanakar uchata ({reason}). Colax janiw uñacht'ayiti agente tinkitätap.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Jaqiru katuyaña colanakar uchata. Browser AI sesiónax sayt'asiski; kuna pachas telefono apayañax janiw ch'amanchatäkiti.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Chiqpach pacha churirix pantjasiw yatiyi. Arux sesión sayt'ayam, ukatx churiri ch'amanchäwip uñakipasax mayampi jikxatam.
messages.voiceActive: Arux sesión lurasiski. Kunapachatix munätaxa “Janîri jaqukipiri k'uchiña” ñit'am; ukax colan mä yänak lurasi, janiw PSTN apayañakiti.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Chiqpach pachan arux churirimp chikt'añax janiw atiskänti.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Aka browserax janiw chiqpach pachan arux yanapkiti.
